title: Creating job search goals
description: You’re 42% more likely to achieve your goals if you put them down in writing. To create goals around your job search, set a target title, start date (the average search takes 3-5 months, though varies depending on lots of factors!), salary range, and number of job applications you’ll commit to each week. As we like to say, what gets measured gets managed. #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #career #shorts
